title: Planroom contract v1, input

imported_through.description: The store `seq` the import that wrote it reached.

rows.description: Each row's outcome, by its docId.

Ack.description: `planroom.ack/v1`: `acks/<uid>`, one per viewer, which the page reads to clear its queued rows.

oneOf.description: Applied, or for a read request, answered.
Waiting for the desk, as a ghost or a pre-selected pick.
Stale against its base: a person conflict card.
Not importable: malformed, or a command a row may not name.

AckStatus.description: What import did with one row, as `acks/<uid>` lists it.

oneOf.description: Such as `person:sridhar` or `person:artifact:u_123`.
Such as `agent:1a2b3c4d:chat` or `agent:cli`.
Such as `typesafe-ai/jev-1.14.0`.
Such as `scan` or `duty:decide`.

handle.description: The handle that asks for this view.

result.description: The command's result, as its `--json` envelope carries it; null when it failed.

error.description: Why the read failed, when it did.

Answer.description:
`planroom.answer/v1`: a read request's result, under `answers/<docId>`, or a view the snapshot
precomputed. Redacted, within the leaf's budget.

Band.description: Which policy band a score fell in.

BatchInfo.description: The items one card applies together.

Category.description: An error's category; the exit code and the HTTP status follow it.

Cause.description: What an event follows from; a chat turn batches ghosts into one card.

Client.description: The client a writer writes from, such as `tab_01J...`, `mod:<sessionId>` or `cli:4242`.

code_sha256.description: The lowercase hex sha256 of the code.

CodeReq.description:
`POST /api/v1/code`: a login code to register, by its sha256, sent with the control token from
`serve.json`, so the code itself never reaches the server's memory or any argv (DR-29, DR-64).

Command.description: One variant per catalogue leaf; the request travels as `args`.

CommandList.description: What `schema --commands` returns: every leaf, summary first.

CommandName.description: A command name from the catalogue, its path joined with spaces.

Cursor.description: An opaque page cursor over `(seq, last_id, filter hash)`.

DbBatch.description: The writes of one `ArtifactData batch` call: at most 50, and at most 1 MiB of documents.

collection.description: The collection path, such as `answers` or `inbox/u_1/events`.

file_path.description: The JSON file whose top-level object is the document, for `set` and `update`.

if_version.description: The version the document was read at; absent when the write creates it.

DbWrite.description: One `db` write, in the shape an `ArtifactData batch` entry takes.

batch.description: Set when the card applies a batch, such as "Apply Claude's 2 edits".

DecisionCard.description: A decision a person is asked to make.

decision_kind.description:
The decision kind's ID. Named `decision_kind`, not `kind`, because `kind` is the event
body's tag.

scores.description: The normalized Jev or Claude result.

DecisionRecord.description: One decision a model or a person made about one subject.

oneOf.description: Counts, top nodes and lifted edges (for agents).
Every node and edge with positions and evidence (for the canvas).

hunk.description: Up to 5, for the first diff only.

DriftLine.description: Intended rules broken and machine drift, in one line.

via_ref.description: A node whose evidence also counts for this edge, such as an endpoint.

EdgeId.description: An edge ID: `e:` plus 12 hex characters of `sha256(kind ‖ from ‖ to ‖ via)`.

fields.description: `put`: the whole node or edge; `set`: the changed fields.

base.description: The `seq` of the view the writer acted on.

over.description: The fact values the fields override, for scan-drift checks.

Empty.description: Why a list or view is empty, and what to do next; no surface shows a blank state.

EmptyReason.description: A snake_case code naming why something is empty.

resolver.description: The resolver, `<plugin root>/scripts/planroom`, once the plugin root is known.

line.description: The one status line for this state: the resolver's message where it gave one.

fix.description: The exact command that fixes this state, when there is one.

EngineState.description: The mod's `engine` atom: written by `session.start` from the resolver's reply (DR-81).

EngineStatus.description: Which pane the mod draws until the engine answers: `ready` draws the `PaneModel` (DR-57, DR-60).

ErrorCode.description: A stable error code. Older readers map an unknown code to its category.

retry_after_ms.description: With `later`, when the caller may try again.

hint.description: An exact command, such as `planroom show ev_01J...`.

details.description: Per code, documented in the registry.

seq.description: One global order: the stream cursor and the store version.

request_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical request; the same `idem` with another hash is refused.

client.description: With `actor`, the writer instance that compare-and-set compares.

anyOf.description: The only event that changes the graph.
Accepts or rejects a ghost, a conflict or an inferred fact.

link.description: The workspace link snapshot of the active set this scan committed.

anyOf.description:
A kind a later version added: the raw body, `kind` included, kept as it was read. The fold
skips it; a read-modify-write or an export writes it back unchanged.

EventBody.description:
An event's body, tagged by its kind. Event kinds are an open set: a body whose `kind` this
version doesn't know decodes as `Unknown`, which holds the raw object, `kind` included, and
serializes it back unchanged, so an older reader neither fails nor drops it.

EventId.description: An event ID: a UUID v7.

EventKind.description: An event's kind, as the `kind` tag of an `EventBody` spells it; an open set.

contains.description: The exact line, cut to 200 characters; omitted in a default Artifact snapshot.

oneOf.description: A file fact: verified against the line index of the blob at `commit`.

A git-derived fact (a tag, a commit, co-change, ownership, the tree at a commit): the commit
is verified to exist, and the ref to name it.

Evidence.description: What a fact was read from, verified at ingest (DR-12).

partial.description: Files read with errors; their facts are weak.

FactBatch.description: What every extractor and linker returns, sorted by ID.

breadcrumb.description: From the top down to the focused node.

session.description: The Claude Code session whose focus to show.

Handle.description: An exact invocation a surface can offer, such as a drill-down or the next action.

HandoffStep.description: One step of the hand-off loop.

id.description: 12 hex characters of `sha256(kind ‖ scope ‖ key ‖ evidence)`.

scope.description: The file, or the compose service.

key.description: The join key: a host, an environment variable name, a path, a queue key.

attrs.description: Scheme, port, path, method, op, driver, default.

Hint.description: A partial observation a linker joins with others, such as a URL literal or an environment read.

HintRef.description: A hint a linked edge joined: its ID and the pack-qualified extractor that emitted it.

path.description: `inbox/<uid>/events/<docId>`, or `live/head` or `acks/<uid>` for a version line.

row.description: The row as the list result showed it; validated as an `InboxRow`.

version.description: The document's version as the list result showed it.

ImportLine.description:
One line of `import -`'s stdin: an inbox row from the observed `ArtifactData list` result,
with its path, which names the author, and its document version, which the delete pins. A line
with no `row` gives the version of a document the session wrote before (`live/head`,
`acks/<uid>`), so the next write to it can pin that version.

source.description: `-`: the rows come only on stdin, never from a file.

ImportReq.description:
`planroom import -`: Artifact inbox rows on stdin, one `ImportLine` per line, from the mod,
which read them from the `ArtifactData list` result it observed (DR-52, DR-67).

person.description: Whether a person's token came with the rows.

ImportResult.description:
What `import -` returns: each row's outcome and the `db` batches the session writes, each with
one `ArtifactData batch` call, in order; `live/head` is the last write of the last batch.

status.description: Its ack; none when the row stays in the inbox for a person's sync.

reason.description: One engine-authored line when the row wasn't imported.

ImportedRow.description: What `import` did with one stdin line.

sample.description: Each Ask Claude call and the model the platform applied, for the ledger.

InboxHead.description:
`inbox/<uid>`: the viewer's own head, which the page bumps after each row, so the session can
list who wrote.

instance.description: Minted by the page on each load: with the uid, the writer instance.

counter.description: Per instance, monotonic; import applies rows in `(instance, counter)` order.

command.description:
`edit`, `review`, `decide` or `intent propose`; or a read request: `map`, `show`, `find`,
`diff`, or an `ask` question that doesn't spend. Import refuses any other.

base.description: The snapshot or live-head `seq` the viewer saw.

source.description: `sample` when the row came from Ask Claude.

sig.description: A paired device's HMAC-SHA256 over the docId and the row without its `sig` (DR-67).

InboxRow.description:
`planroom.inbox/v1`: one row a viewer's page writes to `inbox/{self}/events/{docId}`. Import
validates it, and takes the author from the path, never from the body: a field the row doesn't
define, such as a forged `actor`, is ignored.

LastSeq.description:
The mod's `lastSeq` atom: the `seq` of the last frame the watch loop read, so the loop starts
again from it after a reload (DR-6); null before the first frame (DR-82).

Layer.description: Which layer a fact or edit belongs to.

structure_hash.description: sha256 of the view's block IDs and lifted edges; a changed structure misses the cache.

LayoutKey.description: Where a view's layout is cached: the view and the hash of its structure.

view_key.description: The view the positions belong to, such as `map:system:all`.

structure_hash.description: The hash of the node and edge IDs the layout was computed for.

LayoutPut.description: `PUT /api/v1/layout`: an auto-layout to cache, last writer wins.

name.description: The command name, its path joined with spaces.

budget_tokens.description: The default output budget; 0 for a stream.

schema.description: The `schema --command LEAF` handle for the leaf's types.

LeafSchema.description:
What `schema --command LEAF` returns: the leaf's request and result type names, and every
definition they reference, keyed by name.

Level.description: The five fixed levels, from the plan down to the code.

LiftedEdge.description: Edges lifted to the nearest ancestors at the view's level; `count == children.len()`.

snapshot_seq.description: The `seq` of the published snapshot it extends.

changes.description: The change frames since the snapshot, newest last.

conflicts.description: Engine-authored lines for the conflicts the last import found.

LiveHead.description:
`planroom.live-head/v1`: the small `db` document `live/head` the session writes last in each
sync batch; at most 256 KiB.

tone.description: The kind's block color, which its pack declares; none draws as a plain card (DR-46).

counts.description: Descendants by level name, such as `{"component": 4}`.

position.description: The stored layout position, if any.

ghost.description: Proposed by an agent or a model and not yet accepted by a person.

level.description: The level to show; the top level when absent.

lens.description: The lens; `all` lifts every relation kind.

focus.description: A node ID, an ID suffix or a name to centre on.

hidden.description: Nodes hidden by an override; a hide shows as a count, never as a silent loss.

layout.description:
With `--detail graph`: the key a layout of this view is cached under, which
`PUT /api/v1/layout` takes back.

MapView.description: The map at one level through one lens.

seq.description: The store version this reply reflects; pass it back as `base`.

replayed.description: An idempotent replay of a stored reply.

replayed_from.description: A replay of a derived key: the original `seq`; pass a new `--idem` to repeat the write.

models.description: Absent when no model was called.

model_requests.description: Session backend: requests the mod should fulfil.

Meta.description:
What every reply carries besides its result. Every field but `seq` and `size` is left out when
empty, false, null or zero, and the schema gives each its default (DR-66).

MiniEdge.description: One lifted edge on the mini-map.

MiniMap.description: Up to 60 blocks at the focus level, edges by lens.

ModelRequestRef.description: A model request waiting for the mod (session backend).

props.description: Validated against the kind's prop schema.

Node.description: A thing in the system at one level, with exactly one parent.

diffs.description: The top 3 one-liners; the first with up to 5 hunk lines.

PaneModel.description: What `focus` returns: the pane, the band and the status line; at most 4 KB.

PaneState.description: The mod's `pane` atom: the last `focus --json`, its `PaneModel` or the error it returned.

PartialFile.description: A file an extractor read with errors, such as one that isn't UTF-8.

rekey.description: Replace the registered key with the one on stdin.

base.description: The `seq` of the view you acted on; required when the command writes user-authored state.

idem.description: The idempotency key; derived from the request when absent.

project.description: The project the write belongs to.

PersonInitReq.description:
`planroom person init [--rekey]`: the public key arrives on stdin as the base64url of its
uncompressed SEC1 point (`crypto.subtle.exportKey("raw")`), and the call carries a
`PLANROOM_PERSON_TOKEN` signed by the registered key or by the key on stdin (DR-72, DR-75).

fingerprint.description: The first 16 hex characters of the sha256 of the key's SEC1 bytes.

PersonKey.description:
What `person init` returns: the registered key's fingerprint and when and from where it was
registered.

Progress.description: The plan stage and the work in flight.

oneOf.description: The linker is pack-qualified, such as `code/runtime_wiring`.

Provenance.description: Where a node or edge came from.

files.description: Each published path and the file it comes from.

capabilities.description: The page's capabilities: `db` with its access rules, and `user`.

PublishArgs.description: The exact arguments of the Artifact publish the session makes.

Ref.description: An edge end: a node ID, or an alias another extractor defines, such as `host:orders`.

ok.description: Whether an engine resolved without a fetch.

path.description: The engine binary; absent when the next run would fetch it.

version.description: The engine version this plugin names, from `engine.env`.

ResolverStatus.description:
What `scripts/planroom status --json` prints: the step that resolves the engine, and its path
when one resolved without a fetch.

oneOf.description: `PLANROOM_ENGINE`, used as it is.
A build in the dev checkout.
The data root's engine cache.
A verified download of the release; with `ok: false`, what the next run would do.

ResolverStep.description: The step that resolves the engine, in the order the resolver tries them.

oneOf.description: Retrying the same request can't succeed; a person or another command must act first.
The same request may succeed at once.
Re-read, then retry with the new `seq` as `base`.
Wait, then retry; `retry_after_ms` says how long when known.

Retry.description: When a caller may retry a failed command.

SampleUse.description: One Ask Claude call the page made.

dir.description: The workspace directory; the current directory when absent.

base.description: The `seq` of the view you acted on; required when the command writes user-authored state.

idem.description: The idempotency key; derived from the request when absent.

project.description: The project the write belongs to.

ScanResult.description: What `scan` returns: the map at the top level with the default lens, and the next action.

ScanState.description: Whether the workspace has been scanned.

commands.description: List the command catalogue instead of the schema's summary.

command.description: One leaf's request and result types, with the definitions they reference.

SchemaSummary.description: What `schema` returns: the schema's ID and version, and handles to read further.

login_page.description:
The login page under the data root that opens the canvas with a one-time code, mode 0600;
the code itself is in no output (DR-29, DR-64).

detach.description: Run in the background, in a session of its own, and return at once.

port.description: Move this workspace's canvas to port N and record it; without it, serve uses the recorded port.

SessionReq.description: `POST /api/v1/session`: the one-time code from the login page's URL fragment.

SessionToken.description: The tab's bearer token, kept in `sessionStorage` and sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

out.description: The directory to write the bundle into, such as `.planroom/share`.

include_snippets.description: Keep each evidence line's text in the snapshot (redacted); left out by default.

include_presence.description: Include who is working on what; left out by default.

ShareReq.description:
`planroom share --out DIR [--include-snippets] [--include-presence]`: the canvas built for an
Artifact, `DIR/data/snapshot.json` and the first `live/head`, with the publish's arguments.

summary.description: What will be shared, from the snapshot's sections; the first publish shows it.

db.description: The `db` writes to make after the publish, `live/head` last.

holds.description: What the snapshot holds, as `Snapshot.capabilities` names it.

ShareResult.description:
What `share` returns: the publish to make, the `db` writes that seed `live/head`, and what the
snapshot holds.

path.description:
The published path, such as `assets/main.js` or `data/snapshot.json`; the page itself is
`page.html`.

SharedFile.description: One file `share` wrote, with its size.

snippets.description: Whether evidence keeps its `contains` text; false by default.

maps.description:
The maps it holds, each with its layout positions when one is cached; the page asks for
any other as a read request.

answers.description: Precomputed views, keyed by the handle that asks for each.

capabilities.description:
The views and queries this snapshot serves: `map:<level>:<lens>` for each map it holds,
`pane`, and `answers`.

unavailable.description:
The engine-authored state the page shows for a view it doesn't hold; its `next` names the
read request a press writes to the inbox.

Snapshot.description:
`planroom.snapshot/v1`: what the Artifact page draws with no engine, published as
`data/snapshot.json`. It passes `kernel::redact`, and holds no evidence `contains` unless
`share --include-snippets`, and no presence unless `share --include-presence`.

Stakes.description: How much a wrong pick costs; cards rank by stakes and staleness.

Status.description: An event's state; set at commit and changed only by `review` and `undo` events.

summary.description: One engine-authored line, at most 2 KB.

oneOf.description: One committed event.
The client is too far behind: refetch every view at `seq`.
The stream is alive.

StreamFrame.description: One frame of the live stream.

Target.description: What an edit or claim is about.

oneOf.description: SCIP or LSIF; no v0.1 extractor (DR-11).

Tier.description: How a fact was found, from the least to the most specific tier.

Tone.description:
A Container-level kind's block color: surfaces style a block from its tone, never from a kind
ID (DR-46).

ToolError.description: A tool result's error: the envelope's error less its category.

ToolMeta.description:
The fields of `meta` an agent acts on; absent when empty. `seq` is absent only when the
engine never answered.

error.description: On failure: the error, never dropped.

ToolResult.description:
What a mod tool handler returns, for success and failure alike, as compact JSON text: the
envelope less what an agent doesn't act on. Empty fields are left out (DR-66).

TurnSeq.description:
The mod's `turnSeq` atom: the main loop's current turn and the latest `meta.seq` a tool returned
to the model in it, the default `base` of the tools' writes.

git_commit.description: The commit the binary was built from, when the build recorded one.

target.description: The target triple the binary was built for.

catalogue_hash.description: sha256 of the catalogue as `schema --commands` lists it.

VersionInfo.description: What `version` returns; the mod and the resolver match an engine by its catalogue hash.

Warning.description: A warning attached to a reply.

since.description: Stream the events after this `seq`; the store's latest when absent.

session.description: The Claude Code session this stream serves, as the mod starts it.

WatchReq.description:
`planroom watch [--since SEQ] [--session ID]`: one `StreamFrame` per line on stdout until
stopped.
